card.name: Counts and separators in lists
card.fires_on: Small words or punctuation right after a count or a 'separate/each' phrase, such as 'one' before 'space', a comma after 'commas', or a dash in a number range. It appears in instructions about spacing, grouping or splitting things.

modes.label: Spacing and separating instructions
modes.description: Quantity or punctuation in rules about what separates items or lines.
modes.example: Display 16 characters on each line with<< one>> space between characters.

modes.label: Number ranges and counts
modes.description: A dash or number word inside a range or count of items per unit.
modes.example: involucral collars widely separated, each with 4<<->>12 flowers

modes.label: Group or copy counts in biology
modes.description: A modal or number word about how many copies or groups exist.
modes.example: an egg or a sperm cell<< can>> have an extra copy of an X chromosome
